name: youtube-thumbnail-creator
description: Create YouTube thumbnail concepts, layouts, text overlays, image prompts, variants, and thumbnail critiques from a video title, topic, script, screenshot, or reference image.

interface.longDescription: Turn your YouTube title, topic, script, screenshot, product photo, or creator photo into clear thumbnail concepts. Create short text overlays, visual layouts, thumbnail prompts, multiple variants, critique existing thumbnails, and generate finished thumbnail images when image creation is available.
defaultPrompt: Create three thumbnail concepts for my video title.
Review my thumbnail for mobile readability.
Create a thumbnail from my script.

publication.release_notes: Corrected the ZIP root layout and set the dedicated product page URL. No behavior changes.
